hightron-cyroclaw.notes: Manufacturer and Blade HQ label the blade 3.94 in. Arizona Custom Knives repeats that description but its product-details table says 2.75 in. A 2.44 in edge is also listed. Retained in review queue; excluded from confirmed comparison. Titanium clip does not make the M390 blade titanium.

hoback-talim__titanium-alloy-unspecified.notes: Northern Knives live product specifications explicitly separate 1.8 oz live-blade weight from 3.4 oz with sheath. Price covers the trainer/sheath bundle. Heading and browser title disagree TALIM/TUSK; retain the SKU JHB-TIKARAM PO and URL. Treat as a broader ringless style comparator. Lighter than C.10a.

schwartz-spartan.notes: KnifeCenter SWZ13 lists 4.4 oz INCLUDING sheath (124.74 g). Arizona Custom Knives 1071375 lists 3.7 oz (104.89 g), weight scope unspecified. Do not plot 124.74 g as bare knife or use an estimated 103 g. Both 3.375 in and 3.5 in lengths qualify. Titanium blade with carbidized edge.

medford-burung.notes: KnifeCenter lists 3.45 in, while another supplied catalog lists 3.25 in. Resolve SKU/generation and measurement convention before confirming the minimum.

rogue-custom-titanium.notes: Live Knife-Market listing describes a titanium/Kevlar-carbon-fiber prototype and 3.75 oz. Structured blade length is 100 mm, correcting the supplied 4.75 in claim. Single marketplace seller, unsupported material certification and weight basis; retained for review.

terry-renner-playmates-tactical-hawkbill.notes: Listing is a right/left pair. The 3.4 oz field does not explicitly establish per-knife versus pair mass; excluded from comparable weights.

black-legion-set-karambit.notes: 3.5 in karambit component qualifies by listing. Three color variants and MTech/Black Legion branding collapsed to one catalog entry. 16.3 oz belongs to an unresolved set scope, never to a verified single knife.

boker-wildcat-xl.notes: Boker USA 01BO755 manufacturer specifications list 3.43 in and 5.78 oz. Blade HQ lists 3.375 in and 5 oz for the same identifier. Manufacturer values take precedence; both lengths qualify. Weight disagreement remains in the audit.

boker-straight-karambit.notes: Straight ring-handled design belongs to the broader style group. Current sellers disagree 7Cr17MoV versus 440A; retain both original claims in observations, group under unspecified steel until manufacturer/SKU metallurgy resolves.

tops-tac-tops.notes: TOPS current manufacturer table: blade 7.13 in, cutting edge 5.75 in, knife weight 10 oz, with sheath 14.5 oz. Older 6.125 in catalog convention remains recorded; all values qualify.

tops-10-27.notes: KnifeCenter and Oso Grande currently list 8.6 oz. Supplied 6.8 oz weight is not used. This ring/drop-point hybrid remains in the broader style comparison.

elite-tactical-silverfang.notes: KYGunCo description identifies 3.5 in D2 blade and separates 6.1 oz knife weight from total weight including sheath.

mick-strider-custom.notes: KnifeCenter describes the Level IV Strike Plate blade as titanium in product title, description and blade-material category; alloy and independent certification remain unspecified.

united-cutlery-m48-liberator-falcon.notes: Seller calls the UC3334 a Liberator Falcon with 4.63 in blade; KnifeCenter calls UC3334 Falcon with 5.25 in blade. Names/SKU overlap unresolved. Kept separately from M48 Falcon as an input family; do not assign a verified knife-only weight.

maxace-hela.notes: Qualifying M390 Hela listings span M20A/B/C/E. Current sellers list 6.17 versus 7.30 oz without a clear generation/construction reconciliation. Color/SKU family retained, but no single representative knife weight is chosen.

fox-parong-standard.notes: Fox Americas link in one input refers to a different 2.56 in titanium-frame-lock model. Its specs are excluded from Parong; source URL retained for audit. Parong FX-637T product page lists 3.75 in N690 and 6.7 oz.

emerson-super-karambit.notes: Blade HQ lists 3.375 in; Oso Grande 3.4 in; Knivesandtools 8 cm (3.15 in). SKU/measurement boundary unresolved. EKnives 3–3.49 in is a store filter range, not an exact measurement. Retained as conditional.
